name: valentine-red-dress-portrait
image_vibe: Sensual-but-editorial Valentine styling with crisp red-and-white contrast and soft daylight
image_purpose: Create a Valentine fashion campaign portrait with strong seasonal visual hierarchy.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic vertical Valentine fashion portrait of an original adult woman reclining diagonally on a white sofa in a bright minimalist interior.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long slightly tousled hair, a soft side part, one loose strand near the face, bold red lipstick, light natural makeup, and realistic skin texture. She wears a fitted red satin slip dress with thin straps and soft fabric folds. Preserve the face and facial structure from the attached approved-adult identity reference without changing the outfit or identity.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium framing from the waist or upper thigh upward, subject positioned left/center and reclining diagonally on a large white soft sofa, torso slightly lifted on one elbow, one hand near the temple and the other relaxed on a pillow. Place a large dense bouquet of red roses on the right third, with red petals scattered across the sofa and around the subject. Add large red dripping Valentine lettering in the upper wall area.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight from a side window with subtle fill, warm soft shadows, bright white minimalist room, romantic atmospheric editorial mood, clear red-and-white seasonal contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial photography, eye-level or slightly elevated camera, 35mm look, f/2.8-f/4, ISO 100-200, 1/125s, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic pores and satin texture, subtle film grain, controlled HDR, high detail, no extra text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 Valentine fashion portrait using the attached approved-adult identity reference as the required face reference; preserve the same adult face, facial structure, hairline, hair color and natural skin texture without beautification or face swap. Place her in a bright minimalist room with a white wall and large red dripping paint lettering in the upper frame reading 'Valentine's Day'. Include a large white soft sofa with voluminous cushions, red rose petals scattered on the sofa and around the subject, and a very large dense bouquet of red roses with green leaves occupying the right third. The adult woman looks directly at camera with a confident editorial expression, bold red lipstick, light natural makeup, long slightly tousled hair with a soft side part and one strand over the face. She reclines diagonally on the sofa with her torso slightly lifted on one elbow, one hand raised near the temple and the other relaxed on the front pillow. Preserve the fitted red satin slip dress with thin straps and soft folds along the waist and hips. Use medium waist-to-upper-thigh framing, eye-level or slightly elevated perspective, soft side-window daylight plus subtle fill, warm soft shadows, 35mm look, f/2.8-f/4, ISO 100-200, 1/125s, realistic pores, subtle film grain, controlled HDR, and no extra text, spelling errors, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, different face, identity drift, glossy plastic skin, heavy retouching, airbrush, CGI, illustration, extra objects, spelling errors, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, blurred face, watermark

The identity reference is required; room and floral arrangement may vary slightly while keeping the hierarchy.
